messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "60 mg"
set: ["60 mg", "60 mg per day", "5 mg to 60 mg per day", "60 mg orally once a day", "20 mg to 60 mg per day for OCD", "60 mg/2.4 mL", "60 mg dose was effective for bulimia nervosa", "30 to 60 mg orally once a day", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "20 mg to 60 mg per day for adolescents and higher-weight children", "60 mg once daily in the morning for bulimia nervosa", "60 mg dose was effective in reducing binge-eating and purging behaviors for bulimia nervosa", "10 mg/day to 60 mg/day for panic disorder", "oral disintegrating tablets in children 60 kg or greater: 7.5 mg orally once a day", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "throw away if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
